text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "posts.OwnerUserId semantically references a user (it should match a users table, and badges has its own UserId for that), while badges.Id is a dense sequential badge-award identifier spanning 1–92240, so the 0.875 containment (~79851/92240 ≈ 0.866 expected by chance for integers in that range) is coincidental, not a real reference."}
